messages:
morgan: FYI CI started hitting SAST failures — scanner can't decrypt build artifact. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
sophia: Yep, saw a bunch of alerts. CI job 4823 fails with: ```Error: AccessDeniedException: not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abc123```
lee: I think the RBAC consolidation change from last night removed a binding for the scanner role. Checking PR 789 now.
security-bot: Alert: anomalous KMS Decrypt failures for service account scanner-sa@redwood in last 10m (>120). Suggested action: temporary grant + capture audit logs.
ci-ops: I can apply a short-lived grant to unblock pipeline. Need explicit approval to make a temporary kms grant for scanner-role for 30m.
morgan: Approved. Please add the grant id and times to the incident ticket and post the CloudTrail link here.
ci-ops: Applied temporary grant: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id abc123 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/scanner-role --operations Decrypt --name temp-sast-grant``` Grant id g-7890. Pushed at 2026-03-22T12:34:56Z.
alex: We should also add a fallback to avoid full CI failure next time — e.g., use cached artifacts or image with pre-decrypted test seed. Also add a premerge RBAC diff check.
sophia: Agreed. I'll add a premerge CI step that attempts a dry-run decrypt with a read-only token and fails the PR if permission would be removed.
oncall-sre: CloudTrail shows grant g-7890 and subsequent Decrypt calls from scanner-sa. I've attached the trail link to SI-2026-13. Noting spike aligns with PR 789 merge at 2026-03-22T01:12:03Z.
lee: Root cause: PR 789-role-change removed ``kms:Decrypt`` from the consolidated infra-scanner group binding. Remediation: revert the specific binding in prod and include scoped grant in consolidation PR.
morgan: Triage summary: Blocker mitigated by temp grant; follow-ups — revert prod binding, add premerge check, add audit webhook that posts grant ids to #eng-security automatically, and add an entry to SAST runbook.
sophia: I'll open follow-up PRs for the premerge check and runbook edits. Also adding an automated check that flags keystore permission diffs in PR description.
security-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Temporary grant revoked at 2026-03-22T13:10:02Z. Final audit link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/home?region=us-west-2#/events/g-7890
ci-ops: Confirmed revocation: ```aws kms retire-grant --key-id abc123 --grant-id g-7890``` — no further Decrypt failures after revocation.
alex: Long-term: add RBAC preflight gating to role consolidation changes and a canary in staging that runs SAST against a small corpus to catch decryption regressions.
lee: Adding to playbook: "keystore-perm-diff check" + test harness for ephemeral grants. Will link PRs once ready. :+1:
morgan: Thanks everyone — closing thread once PRs are open.
